title: UPI volume, value post strong growth during Diwali as festive spending lights up digital payments
summary: UPI transaction volume and value surge during Diwali week, hitting Rs 1.37 lakh crore on Dhanteras
detailed: This year, November 6, which coincided with Dhanteras, recorded UPI transactions worth Rs 1.37 lakh crore, the second-highest daily transaction value on record. Dhanteras is traditionally considered as an auspicious day to make high-value purchases. Transaction volumes hit a record the following day
